summary_md: **Hoffman ([@Omer_Hoffman](https://x.com/Omer_Hoffman/status/2115727335244619972))** releases a **Sandstorm IC-LoRA** for LTX-2.5 that re-renders an input clip inside a storm of chosen density using the trigger phrase "ADD SANDSTORM" at strength 1, and follows up with a further demo clip of the effect ([Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Hoffm4nz/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Sandstorm)).
relevance: Open video-to-video effect LoRA for local pipelines.

media.description: Follow-up video showing the Sandstorm IC-LoRA effect on a clip (not downloaded; referenced only).
